sloka: अहम्पुर्वाः पचन्ति स्म प्रशस्तम् पानभोजनम् ।स कथन्नु कषायाणि तिक्तानि कटुकानि च ॥२-१२-९९॥
transliteration: ahampurvāḥ pacanti sma praśastam pānabhojanam ।sa kathannu kaṣāyāṇi tiktāni kaṭukāni ca ॥2-12-99॥

translations.english: How will my son for whom the cooks with kundalas in their ears used to proudly prepare enough food and beverages subsist on astringent, pungent, bitter wild fruits and roots?
